scope: 48 epoch component chains and exact key-material producer audit; temporary compiler output, no production files mutated by this review

checks.key_previous_artifact: only the immediate predecessor; no key used by component recipes
checks.base_material_producer_coverage: all normalized base materials have native/custom producers or identified non-recipe routes

resolved_material_findings.evidence: No exported producer for original; canonical route alltheores:crafting/iron/plate uses 2 iron ingots and an alltheores:ore_hammers tag tool. Copper/iron ore hammers available epoch1; plate item available epoch2, native recipe gate3. Does not need the epoch4 mechanical press. Original may have a non-recipe procedural hammer route; normalization makes the supported route explicit.

Zero original ID recipe mentions. immersiveengineering:crafting/plate_steel_hammering uses steel ingot + IE hammer, both available epoch8; native Create steel pressing produces the same canonical item.
industrialforegoing:iron_gear recipe output is rewritten to MI iron gear. MI gear available epoch6.

No original item producer among 42064 native recipes. Oritech biosteel smelting, foundry and casting all output IE steel after unification. New epoch25/26 matrix recipes use Oritech foundry with steel + raw_biopolymer to retain the biopolymer requirement.
Zero recipe mentions of Etrium ingot. Ostrum has actual producers and is available epoch37; Calorite remains the epoch38 technical material.

bootstrap_reviews.result: Explicit aia2:bootstrap/epoch_04_1 crafting recipe uses Create iron sheet plus overworld redstone/root/diamond/bark; no future altar dependency.

Native botania:mana_infusion with iron uses epoch5 pool/spreader; livingrock via Pure Daisy/petal apothecary is available epoch5. Component catalysts before epoch9 use pool infusion rather than prematurely requiring Runic Altar.
Explicit bootstrap replaces Nether brick dependency with brick, livingrock, coal coke and sand, before Nether opens epoch15.
Nature Altar and Runic Altar both open epoch9. Patched Runic Altar crafting needs livingrock, mana pearl, IE iron component, so it does not require its own rune output.

Brass bootstrap mixes unheated, avoiding a Blaze Burner before Nether15. Quartz is obtainable from traded quartz blocks with native cyclic:shapeless/quartz (recipe gate0), so electron tubes do not force early Nether entry.

Patched crafting uses adamant, motor, copper, vanilla crafter, PCB and iesnium. Adamant and motor retain direct crafting routes independent of assembler; crafter opens10, PCB24, iesnium14. First assembler does not depend on a new convergence component.

Epoch40 uses wyvern injectors available40; epoch41-42 draconic level uses awakened injectors available41; epoch43+ chaotic uses chaotic injectors available42. Native injector upgrades use lower tier injectors, and previous convergence core is always an earlier already craftable component, not an epoch key.

Native serializer has implicit output. Existing aia2:rebalance/avaritia/infinity_catalyst removes the bedrock ingredient and original native ID is removed. Export-only output scanning would incorrectly mark this material missing.
Native mechanism recipe uses item_output, not generic result/output. mekanism:processing/lategame/polonium_pellet/from_reaction is a real producer; generic output-only scanning is insufficient.

limitations: This targeted static audit does not prove full native worldgen, boss spawn tables, ritual dispatch, inventory interaction or gameplay balance.
Loot/procedural resources (old_root, bark, naga_scale, buffalo_hide, Wilden Tribute, Gaia Spirit) legitimately need non-recipe obtainability checks in the installed modpack.
Runtime adapters and TPS require actual Minecraft/NeoForge integration testing.
Authored quest catalogs were incomplete during this review; their full graph and late epoch28 source-network goals are checked separately after compilation.
